verdict.rationale: The Claude Agent SDK is the Claude Code agent loop made programmable: it spawns and supervises the claude CLI agent. That puts it in the agent (MCP client) role, not the role of serving tools to other agents. Its MCP evidence covers only client-side use: connecting to local, HTTP, or in-process MCP servers to give its own agent tools. Nothing shows the SDK itself running as an official MCP server, such as an 'mcp serve' mode or a hosted endpoint, for outside agents to connect to. This is a judgment call: if the SDK were treated as a general framework rather than an agent, the verdict would be 'none'.
